answer: Audit like an epidemiologist. Each epoch a random beacon picks a few keys for a deep check; when one turns out to be a hollow shell, every key it traded with, graded, or paid in the last 90 days is checked next, then their contacts in turn. Honest agents deal with a wide, mixed crowd, so the trace fizzles after a hop or two. A farm's keys pass nectar around a tight loop, so one exposed key becomes a bridge into the whole ring and the cascade unwinds it within a few rounds, freezing each confirmed fake.
